person.persName: dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan
gzhung rgya smra ba rin chen tshul khrims
person.note: [4TBERVZD]: 72, n. 16 suggests that the "Rin chen tshul khrims" who composed work (ID:5271) could be the thirteenth abbot of the Bye rdzing pa monastic community and teacher of Dol po pa (ID:4213). The approximated dates are based on this assumption. A "Rin chen tshul khrims" (ID:7135) was a student of Dol po pa, see (ID:7135); his dates (1297-1368) were adopted for the author of (ID:5271) in [J4L5X9AG]: 431. It is not certain whether the same "Rin chen tshul khrims" was the author of work (ID:5271) and of work (ID:6991).

bibl.title: tshad ma rnam nges kyi legs par bshad pa 'grel bshad kun las btus pa'i snying po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba
ཚད་མ་རྣམ་ངེས་ཀྱི་ལེགས་པར་བཤད་པ་འགྲེལ་བཤད་ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས་པའི་སྙིང་པོ་ཉི་མའི་འོད་ཟེར་གྱི་སྣང་བ

lus kyi bstan bcos bar pa tshad ma rnam nges kyi legs par bshad pa 'grel pa kun las btus pa'i snying po nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba
bibl.author: rin chen tshul khrims
bibl.note: Commentary on the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774) making abundant use of arguments in thal-phyir format, with use of the pronoun "khyod" as a variable, to explain the base text. The Pramāṇaviniścaya is not cited, but initial syllables of the passages addressed by the commentary have been added below the lines in instance (ID:5270). The identity of the author is uncertain and it is not clear whether the same "Rin chen tshul khrims" was the author of this work and of work (ID:6991).

bibl.title: tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i legs par bshad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba las le'u gsum pa'i bsdus don
ཚད་མ་རྣམ་པར་ངེས་པའི་ལེགས་པར་བཤད་པ་ཉི་མའི་འོད་ཟེར་གྱི་སྣང་བ་ལས་ལེའུ་གསུམ་པའི་བསྡུས་དོན
tshad ma rnam par nges pa'i legs par bshad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba las le'u gsum pa'i bsdus don (colophon)
bibl.author: rin chen tshul khrims
bibl.note: In view of the incipit and colophon reported in [4TBERVZD]: 14, this is a topical outline on the three chapters of the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774), presumably by the same person who authored a commentary with the same title, work (ID:5271), i.e., Rin chen tshul khrims (ID:5954).

bibl.title: chos mngon pa mdzod kyi bsdus don
ཆོས་མངོན་པ་མཛོད་ཀྱི་བསྡུས་དོན
mngon pa mdzod kyi bsdus don
bibl.author: rin chen tshul khrims
bibl.note: An instance of this work is listed in [8H6M69W4]: No. 16078. In view its title and the number of folios of instance (ID:6992), it is a topical outline or a concise guide on the Abhidharmakośa (ID:3761). The identity of the author is uncertain and it is not clear whether the same "Rin chen tshul khrims" was the author of this work and of work (ID:5271).
